Composition: exactly 8 equal columns x 4 equal rows, landscape sheet. Each sprite centered in its own invisible cell with generous fully transparent gutters and margin. Entire head, hands, feet, costume, tail/wings when present must fit intact. No sprites touching.

No weapons, staves, held tools, baked spells, magic particles, aura, ground shadow, ground plane, scene, labels, letters, watermarks, visible grid or checkerboard. Actual transparent background with alpha=0 between figures.
